question: How many films are in the catalog?
Top 5 most-rented films
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY rentals DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Total revenue per store
gold_sql: SELECT s.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN staff st ON st.staff_id = p.staff_id JOIN store s ON s.store_id = st.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id;

question: Customers from Canada
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN address a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada';

question: Average rental duration in days
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(return_date) - julianday(rental_date)) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL;

question: Actors who appear in more than 30 films
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(*) AS films FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id HAVING films > 30 ORDER BY films DESC;

question: Most popular category by rental count
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id=r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id=i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id=fc.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY rentals DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Films never rented
gold_sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id=i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id=f.film_id);

question: Top customers by spending
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS spent FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Films with rating 'PG-13' and length > 120 min
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating='PG-13' AND length > 120;

question: Monthly revenue trend
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS m, SUM(amount) AS rev FROM payment GROUP BY m ORDER BY m;

question: Staff productivity (rentals per staff)
gold_sql: SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, COUNT(*) AS handled FROM rental r JOIN staff s ON s.staff_id=r.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id ORDER BY handled DESC;

question: Films available at both stores
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.title FROM film f WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory WHERE film_id=f.film_id AND store_id=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory WHERE film_id=f.film_id AND store_id=2);

question: Average payment per customer segment by country
gold_sql: SELECT co.country, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_payment FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id=p.customer_id JOIN address a ON a.address_id=c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id=a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id=ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY avg_payment DESC;

question: Films where every actor appears in more than 20 films
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_actor fa WHERE fa.film_id=f.film_id AND fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id HAVING COUNT(*) <= 20));
